scripts.translation:
[学者]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It takes a lifetime...
Literally a lifetime
to amass the knowledge
necessary to become
a Scholar...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
这需要一生...真的是一生，才能积累成为学者所需的知识...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It's overwhelming.
The more you learn, the
more you discover what
else you don't know.
There's no end to the
process of learning...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
真是令人感慨。
学得越多，就越能发现自己的无知。
求知之路，永无止境...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Midgard doesn't
have enough Scholars to
help usher in a new age
of prosperity. The
world needs you...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
米德加尔特需要更多学者，帮助世人迎来繁荣的新时代。
这个世界需要你...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Will you take this
awesome responsibility?
Will you serve Midgard
as a Scholar?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你愿意肩负这份重任，以学者的身份为米德加尔特效力吗？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[学者]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Congratulations!
As a Professor, I hope
that you will take an
active part in bringing
the light of knowledge
where there is darkness.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
恭喜！
愿你身为智者，积极将知识之光带到黑暗之处。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[学者]
在这里安心休息吧。
向勇士们致敬！
